EmailMassaWelcome

Your first campaign in 3 steps

Thanks for installing. It takes about 2 minutes, keep this tab open while you do it.

  1. Connect your Gmail

    Click the puzzle icon at the top right of Chrome, pin EmailMassa with the pin and click its icon. Then press this button:

    EmailMassa
    GContinue with Google

    Google will ask for two permissions: send email (your campaigns) and Google Sheets (only the sheets you pick). Allow both. We never read your inbox. Why we ask.

  2. Open a new email in Gmail

    Click Compose. Next to the Send button you will see the green Massa button:

    Send✉ Massa▾

    Click the small arrow ▾ on Massa to add recipients: paste emails, upload a CSV or pick a Google Sheet.

  3. Send yourself a test

    Write using the columns of your list. Each person gets the email with their own name:

    Subject: {{name}}, an idea for {{company}}Hi {{name}}, I saw the {{company}} website and had an idea...

    Use Send test first and check it in your inbox. Looks right? Click Massa and the campaign goes out.

Open Gmail

Free plan: 1 campaign per day, 30 in total. Inside Gmail a short guide walks you through each step.

P.S.Stuck on a step? Message us on WhatsApp, a real person answers.
